observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: outdoor stone courtyard in front of a rustic stone wall with windows
observation.formation_and_space: solo dancer moving around the open stone and grass area
observation.posture: upright torso, relaxed knees, varying weight shifts between feet
observation.footwork: springy steps, light jogs, and hops on the beat; exact foot contact cannot be fully detailed due to video framing
observation.arms_and_hands: holding and striking coconut shells attached to the chest, shoulders, waist, and knees, clapping them together in rhythms
observation.hips_and_torso: minimal torso twists and bends to facilitate striking coconut shells on different body parts
observation.levels_jumps_turns: low jumps, light leaping hops, and pivoting turns
observation.costume_and_props: white short-sleeved shirt with a red sash/collar, orange trousers, coconut shell halves strapped to chest, back, waist, thighs, and knees, barefoot
observation.cannot_infer: exact footwork details, weight distribution, and subtle floor contact are obscured by wide camera angles and low-resolution framing

instruments: accordion or similar folk reed instrument

signature_moments.what: Solo male dancer hopping lightly while striking coconut shells strapped to his knees and chest in rhythm with the music.
Dancer shifting weight side to side while clapping coconut shells held in hands against the shells strapped to his body.
